result.instructions: Tools for Bob Go, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What will it cost to send a 2 kg parcel from Johannesburg to Cape Town with each courier?"; "Which of our shipments failed to reach a courier this month?"; "Where is shipment UATCG4X7Q2 right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bob Go data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bobgo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bobgo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bobgo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bobgo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bobgo_get_checkout_rates
tools.title: Get checkout shipping rates
tools.description: Return the shipping options a buyer should see at checkout, priced by the rules configured in the Bob Go account (service levels, zones, markups, exclusions). Use it for a cart, not to pick a courier to book. An empty result means no delivery for that area, not an error. Bob Go: POST /v2/rates-at-checkout.

tools.name: bobgo_get_courier_rates
tools.title: Quote courier rates for parcels
tools.description: Ask every courier on the Bob Go account what the parcels cost to ship between two addresses. Returns per-courier quotes with rate_amount; use only rates with status success. This is a quote, not a booking, and it does not apply the account's checkout markups. Waits up to about 20 seconds for couriers (timeout_ms). Bob Go: POST /v2/rates.

tools.name: bobgo_get_rate_request
tools.title: Get a courier rate request
tools.description: Read a rate request made earlier, with the couriers' answers so far. Use it after bobgo_get_courier_rates returned a pending provider. Without an id it lists the most recent rate requests. Bob Go: GET /v2/rates.

rate_request_id.description: The id returned by bobgo_get_courier_rates. Omit to list recent rate requests.

tools.name: bobgo_create_shipment
tools.title: Book a shipment (charges the account)
tools.description: BOOKS a courier for the parcels and charges the customer's own Bob Go account once the courier rate is known. Take provider_slug and service_level_code from a rate you selected. The call returns at once with submission_status pending-rates; check it later with bobgo_list_shipments (id) before you tell anyone the parcel is booked. Bob Go: POST /v2/shipments.

provider_slug.description: Courier slug from the selected rate, e.g. tcg.

service_level_code.description: Service level code from the selected rate, e.g. ECO.

tools.name: bobgo_list_shipments
tools.title: List or look up shipments
tools.description: List shipments, newest first, or fetch one by id or tracking_reference. Without id, tracking_reference or a date range, only the current month (South African time) is returned: send start_date and end_date for older shipments. Use submission_status to find bookings that never reached a courier. Bob Go: GET /v2/shipments.

tracking_reference.description: Bob Go tracking reference, e.g. UATCG4X7Q2.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (default 100 for orders and shipments).

start_date.description: Shipments created from this date. Send end_date with it.

end_date.description: Shipments created up to this date.

order.description: Sort direction. Only applies together with order_by.

order_by.description: Field to sort on, e.g. time_created.

tools.name: bobgo_cancel_shipment
tools.title: Cancel a shipment (refunds the charge)
tools.description: CANCELS a shipment and refunds its charge to the customer's Bob Go account. Bob Go refuses it once the courier has moved the parcel past collection. Use the Bob Go tracking_reference, not your custom reference. Bob Go: POST /v2/shipments/cancel.

tracking_reference.description: Bob Go tracking reference of the shipment to cancel.

note.description: Reason. It appears on the shipment's cancelled tracking event.

tools.name: bobgo_get_waybill
tools.title: Get shipment waybill PDF
tools.description: Generate the A4/A5/A6 waybill PDF for shipments and return a download_url (valid 24 hours). Cancelled or unknown references are skipped. Shipments that the courier has not accepted yet produce no label: read submission_status per shipment. Two or more shipments are always queued: then poll bobgo_get_file with file_history_id. Bob Go: GET /v2/shipments/waybill.

tracking_references.description: Bob Go tracking references to print. Send this or ids.

ids.description: Shipment ids to print. Send this or tracking_references. With both, only shipments matching both are printed.

paper_size.description: Sheet size. Defaults to the account setting.

waybill_size.description: Waybill size on the sheet. Cannot be larger than paper_size.

tools.name: bobgo_get_sticker_waybill
tools.title: Get sticker label (ZPL or PDF)
tools.description: Generate sticker labels for shipments. type zpl returns ZPL strings inline, one per parcel, for a Zebra printer. type pdf returns the same envelope as the waybill. Sticker labels need a Bob Go plan that includes them. Bob Go: GET /v2/shipments/sticker-waybill.

tracking_references.description: Bob Go tracking references to print.

tools.name: bobgo_get_file
tools.title: Collect a queued label file
tools.description: Read a queued label or waybill batch. Poll until file_status leaves processing; file_url is set on success and valid 24 hours. Records are kept for a month. Bob Go: GET /v2/file-history.

file_history_id.description: The file_history_id from a queued waybill or sticker response.

tools.name: bobgo_get_tracking_events
tools.title: Get tracking history
tools.description: Return every tracking checkpoint for a shipment, with its current status and the courier's branding. Not limited to this account: any Bob Go tracking reference resolves, as on the public tracking page. Bob Go: GET /v2/tracking (returns an array).

tracking_reference.description: Bob Go tracking reference, e.g. UATCG4X7Q2.

tools.name: bobgo_list_orders
tools.title: List or look up orders
tools.description: List orders on the account, most recently placed first, or fetch one by id. Filter by payment, order or fulfilment status, delivery province code or date placed. Items and relations are included by default: ask only for what you need. Bob Go: GET /v2/orders.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100 (default 100 for orders and shipments).

end_date.description: Orders placed up to this date.

order.description: Sort direction. Only applies together with order_by.

order_by.description: Field to sort on, e.g. date_placed_on_channel.

delivery_address_zone.description: Province codes, e.g. ["GP","WC"]. Names such as Gauteng match nothing.

include_relations.description: Include the delivery address, channel and tags (default true).

include_fulfillments.description: Include fulfilments and their tracking references (default false).

tools.name: bobgo_get_order_fulfillments
tools.title: Get an order's fulfilments
tools.description: List every fulfilment (shipment or buyer collection) on an order, newest first. The tracking reference of an order's shipment is here, not on the order. Bob Go: GET /v2/order-fulfillments.

order_id.description: The Bob Go order id (from bobgo_list_orders).
